title: .agents/state/drift-report.json (written by /agentive:update: user-modified files and managed regions that were kept, with their differences against the current template; created regions, the stale-line check and errors)
description: /agentive:update overwrites files and managed regions whose sha256 still equals the manifest.generated baseline (listed in overwritten) and keeps every file or region whose hash differs from the baseline, or that has no record, as user-modified, listing each as an item. The user then tells Claude in natural language which items to accept. With the explicit --force option, items with reason customized are overwritten as well and listed in forced (with the sha256 they had); no_baseline items are never overwritten by --force. A customization that should survive updates belongs in .agents/custom/ (override_path names the file); override files are user-owned and never appear here. A managed region is a START/END block inside a shared file (spec.init_apply.managed_regions); the field `section` holds its region id and the item id is <path>#<region>. Content outside the markers is never read or written. Regions that did not exist are created at the end of the file and listed in created. Before regions are rewritten update runs the stale-line check (stale_check, stale): a path a region names that is gone from the working tree, with the commit that deleted or renamed it read from that path's own history; no sha is stored anywhere (REGIONNOSHA, E2E-09). A file whose markers are malformed is left untouched and listed in errors. Item ids are stable across runs (<path> or <path>#<region>) and each id is in only one of overwritten, forced, created and items, and unique within each (update checks this; JSON Schema cannot express it).

overwritten.description: files and regions whose hash equalled the baseline (not user-modified) and were replaced by the new templates

items.description: user-modified files and regions that were kept (hash differs from the baseline, or no baseline record), including a region whose markers were deleted (a removed difference)

forced.description: user-modified files and regions that --force replaced with the new template; empty or absent unless force is true

created.description: files and regions that did not exist and were created by this run (a region appended to an existing shared file, or a new file); outside content is untouched

reason.description: required when skipped: no_commits (an empty repository: no history to read), not_a_git_repository. The existence check of doc-pointer paths still runs and its hits are in stale[] with commit null

since.description: HEAD of the previous /agentive:update run, read from the previous drift report (untracked); null when there is none. Informational: the check uses no stored sha

until.description: HEAD sha of this run (the last time the stale-line check ran is this report's generated_at)

stale_check.description: sha-free stale-line check over the managed regions (spec.init_apply.managed_regions.stale_check, REGIONNOSHA): each path a region body names that is not in the working tree is looked up with `git log -1 -M --full-diff --diff-filter=DR --name-status -- <path>`

stale.description: region lines that name a path that is gone from the working tree: deleted or renamed in the history (commit), or a doc-pointer path that is missing (commit null)

errors.description: units left untouched because of an error

id.description: stable id: <path> for a whole file, <path>#<region> for a managed region of a shared file

section.description: region id when the unit is a managed region (the id then is <path>#<region>)
region id when the unit is a managed region (the id then is <path>#<region>)

reason.description: customized: current sha256 differs from manifest.generated (the file is user-modified); no_baseline: no record exists (for example a file that existed before the framework)

differences.description: differences of the current content against the current template

override_path.description: where the user can put this customization so the generated file stays framework-owned: the same relative path under .agents/custom/ (spec.init_apply.update.custom_overrides). A hint only; update never writes there.

section.description: region id when the unit is a managed region (the id then is <path>#<region>)

reason.description: only user-modified items (hash differs from the baseline) can be forced; a no_baseline item is never overwritten by --force

previous_sha256.description: sha256 of the user's version that --force replaced

named_path.description: the path that the region line names

commit.description: commit that last deleted or renamed the path (path-scoped git log); null when the history holds no such commit, for example a doc-pointer file deleted but not committed, or a repository without commits

resolution.description: refreshed: the region was unmodified and rewritten from current evidence; reported: the region is user-modified and kept, so the line is only reported

code.description: malformed_markers: not exactly one START and one END, START after END, or nesting; the file is not written. invalid_override: an override file under .agents/custom/ could not be merged. unparsable_json: a JSON settings file that is merged by key (.claude/settings.json, .codex/hooks.json) is not strict JSON (a comment, a trailing comma); it is not written. hook_smoke_failed: an installed hook script did not exit 0 on a sample input, so the settings file that wires it is not written
